frase_gancho.texto: The country house of a Taxco miner, which became the residence of emperors.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The Borda Garden began as the retreat of a silver miner, and its French-style gardens, its fountains and its lake were completed in seventeen eighty-three. In eighteen sixty-five, Emperor Maximilian and Empress Carlota chose it as their summer residence. Today it is a cultural center open to the public. Here lives the layer of rest.
